input: Research fertility clinics in my city

gold.taskTitle: Research fertility clinics in my city
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate fertility clinics in the user's local area to support a fertility-related decision or next step.

questions.title: Which city or region should the search cover?
questions.description: Identify the specific city or geographic area to focus the clinic search on.

questions.title: What specific treatment are you looking into?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is researching IVF, IUI, egg freezing, fertility testing, or another specific service.

questions.title: Is this for an individual or a couple?
questions.description: Clarify whether one or both partners will be involved in treatment, as this affects clinic requirements.

questions.title: Do you have a specific timeline or urgency in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to book a consultation soon or is in early exploratory stages.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget or insurance situation?
questions.description: Understand whether cost is a major factor and whether the user has fertility coverage through insurance.

questions.title: What matters most when comparing clinics?
questions.description: Find out the user's top priorities, such as success rates, doctor reputation, wait times, or location convenience.

questions.title: Have you already visited or ruled out any clinics?
questions.description: Identify any clinics the user has already considered to avoid duplicating research already done.
